programs.title: CHIP-8 Logo
programs.description: Draws the CHIP-8 logo with the six simplest instructions: the first check that the screen works.

programs.title: IBM Logo
programs.description: The classic first program: clear, load, draw and jump.

programs.title: Corax+
programs.description: Runs every arithmetic, logic and branch instruction and ticks each one off on screen.

programs.title: Flags
programs.description: Checks VF after every carry, borrow and shift, in both orders.

programs.title: Quirks
programs.description: Finds which quirks the interpreter has, for CHIP-8, SUPER-CHIP or XO-CHIP chosen with keys 1 to 3, and says whether they match. Change them in TUNE.

programs.title: Keypad
programs.description: Tests the three key instructions, EX9E, EXA1 and FX0A, one key at a time. Choose with keys 1 to 3.

programs.title: Beep
programs.description: Beeps SOS in morse and flashes a speaker; hold B to beep by hand.

programs.title: Scrolling
programs.description: Scrolls down, left and right in both resolutions: every arrow should land in its box.
